== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Blizzard 2 (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata)]] (<code>1220_81</code>, Virtual Block 2 slip 81), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 2 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-81-Blizzard_2.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-D-blizzard2-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Blizzard 2 (V) (Virtual Block 2)]]; the Master List (2013) reprints the original.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205214/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142857/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of March to May 2013 carry no game text. Published typos and punctuation are kept as printed; icons the source writes out in words are drawn as the slips print them.
* '''PC-E1 text (card list):''' “May add 1 pilot and 8 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. During your control phase, may take one Trample or Walker Barrage into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Walker Barage total is +2. Immune to attrition < 4.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1220_81</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 2 set mark, caption, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB2-81-Blizzard_2-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B32 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
